description: R-CAT-1 fixture r-cat-1b-qd: the base tables plus one saved QueryDef per shape (select, update, delete, append, make-table, crosstab, union, DDL, parameterized select), a parameterized update QParamUpd, and a pass-through QPass whose Connect names a data source that does not exist. Built through DAO in one program on a new ACCDB (DBEngine.CreateDatabase, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); each call's outcome is recorded and the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(20), B LONG, C DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE U (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_U PRIMARY KEY, TID LONG, V TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(20))
SELECT ID, A, B * 2 AS Twice FROM T WHERE B > 5 ORDER BY ID;
UPDATE T SET B = B + 1 WHERE ID > 0;
INSERT INTO W (ID, A) SELECT ID + 100, A FROM T;
SELECT ID, A INTO TNew FROM T;
TRANSFORM Sum(B) AS SB SELECT A FROM T GROUP BY A PIVOT ID;
SELECT ID, A FROM T UNION ALL SELECT ID, A FROM W;
PARAMETERS pId Long, pName Text ( 20 ); SELECT ID, A FROM T WHERE ID = pId OR A = pName;
PARAMETERS pV Long; UPDATE T SET B = pV WHERE ID = 1;
